items.name: motion-doctrine
items.author: heygen-com
items.description: Gateway motion law for HyperFrames—continuous camera feel, vector seams, and performance-first animation rules.
items.summary: This gateway HyperFrames skill establishes the high-level motion law that makes multi-scene videos feel like one continuous camera move. It defines the vector law, film current, carrier elements, causal motion, Seam Gate enforcement, and rules against idle wobble between beats. Authoring order starts with a vector ledger, seam stamping, sustained-motion routes, then verification via seam-gate scripts. Load it first before any HyperFrames animation; it routes to cut-the-curve, oversized-cursor, and seam-craft for implementation.
highlights: Vector law: exit axis, direction, speed, and phase must match the next entry
Seam Gate enforcement and ban on idle wobble—motion must perform
Routes to cut-the-curve, oversized-cursor, and seam-craft technique skills

items.name: captions-overlay
items.author: heygen-com
items.description: Apply HyperFrames caption overlay doctrine for talking-head and launch videos without reserved keep-out bands.
items.summary: This HyperFrames skill defines caption overlay doctrine for talking-head and product launch videos. Captions are composited on top of the film using drop, rail, or embed models rather than reserving a bottom keep-out band that shifts content upward. It applies on top of the embedded-captions upstream skill and quotes the rail-plus-embed model from product-launch-video scene guidance. Load it when adding subtitles or deciding how phrases should ride the rail versus embed at climax moments.
highlights: Caption overlay doctrine: drop, rail, and embed models composited on film
No reserved bottom keep-out band—captions overlay content by design
Pairs with embedded-captions upstream skill for launch video workflows

items.name: cut-the-curve
items.author: heygen-com
items.description: Implement HyperFrames velocity-matched seams, waterfall entries, and nudge curves for transitions and kinetic text.
items.summary: This HyperFrames technique catalog documents five velocity-matched seam transitions plus two in-scene techniques. Seams include zoom-through, inverse zoom-through, cut-the-curve, waterfall cut, and rack-focus blur-cut with mirrored power4 eases and partial-travel matching. In-scene techniques cover waterfall entry for title cards and the nudge curve for slow-fast-slow group repositioning. Read it before authoring any transition, text-beat handoff, kinetic text entry, or group slide in HyperFrames films.
highlights: Five velocity-matched seams: zoom-through, inverse zoom, cut-the-curve, waterfall, rack-focus
Waterfall entry cascades and nudge curve three-phase group slides
Mirrored power4 eases with partial-travel velocity matching (~12% frame)

items.name: seam-craft
items.author: heygen-com
items.description: Fix HyperFrames master-timeline seam render issues like white flashes and opacity dips at scene cuts.
items.summary: This HyperFrames skill covers render-correctness prerequisites for scene-to-scene seams on the master timeline. It explains the opaque stage-ground white-flash guard, how overlapping scene wrappers blend, final-frame holds, track ping-pong behavior, and lint-clean template stamping. Load it when assembling index.html, debugging white flashes at cuts, or verifying opacity dips on dark films. It does not replace the transition registry—that remains in cut-the-curve.
highlights: Opaque stage-ground guard preventing white flashes at dark-film seams
Master timeline injector overlap, final-frame holds, and track ping-pong rules
Render prerequisites separate from per-transition catalog entries
